title: Battle of Okinawa
summary: The Battle of Okinawa (Operation Iceberg) was a roughly three-month US campaign, beginning with landings on 1 April 1945, to seize 640 square miles of the Ryukyu Islands, about 340 miles from mainland Japan. The National WWII Museum calls it the largest battle of the Pacific War and the last major battle of the war.

uncertainty.note: Start is the 1 April landings; end 22 June is the Tenth Army flag-raising marking victory, per the museum page.

where.modern_name: Okinawa Island, Okinawa, Japan (pin is a proxy at the island's approximate centre)
where.historical_name: Okinawa Island, Ryukyu Islands, Empire of Japan

importance.justification: Described as the largest and last major battle of the Pacific War, fought close to the Japanese home islands.

audience_note: Describes a battle with very heavy military and civilian casualties.
